description: Source file implementing the SimpleIndex class for disk cache management, including cache entry metadata, initialization, eviction, and disk writing logic.

classes.name: EntryMetadata
classes.description: Holds metadata for cache entries, including last used time, size, trailer prefetch size, and in-memory data flag.

classes.name: SimpleIndex
classes.description: Manages cache index entries, including initialization, insertion, removal, eviction, and disk persistence.

methods.name: EntryMetadata::Serialize
methods.description: Serializes entry metadata into a pickle for disk storage.

methods.name: EntryMetadata::Deserialize
methods.description: Deserializes entry metadata from a pickle.

methods.name: SimpleIndex::Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the index, loading entries from disk.

methods.name: SimpleIndex::SetMaxSize
methods.description: Sets maximum cache size and computes watermarks for eviction.

methods.name: SimpleIndex::Insert
methods.description: Inserts a new entry into the index.

methods.name: SimpleIndex::Remove
methods.description: Removes an entry from the index.

methods.name: SimpleIndex::UpdateEntrySize
methods.description: Updates the size of an existing entry.
